scope: Isolated emitted native/full Skeuomorph tactile demos at CPU1/4, desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2. Eight-second scripted DOM events exercise real source controllers and dial springs/tick updates, complete timer drums/countdown and key press/save/icon swaps, active caller holds, queued actions and resume. Actual RAF intervals, long tasks, cold first paint, readiness and CDP traces are recorded. Fonts are prepared before mounting; state is read only at endpoints. Physical input and original-model equivalence are verified separately. All three controls reject audio construction. Measurements exclude route transfer and do not pass final timing gates.

checkoutLineEndings.policy: Measured source hashes bind actual checkout bytes. Only these unchanged UTF-8 files differ from their Git blobs by CRLF to LF normalization. Every new or changed payload must match the Git index exactly before publication.

beforeOptimization.changes: Stable metric caching, inherited common glyph styles, one dirty-field paint per clock sample, cached owned style writes, and only the required native motion constructor. Original source programs, complete history, native geometry and canonical trajectories remain unchanged.
